title: Gate Transition Decision
description: Determines whether a gate should pass, block, request approval, continue validation, or fail closed.
intent: Decide the next legal gate transition (PASS / BLOCK / CONTINUE / AWAITING_APPROVAL) for a task from the reconciled G2 execution result and exact readback evidence, without performing the transition or granting any gate authority.
outcome: Typed GateTransitionDecision with decision, reason_code, transition, expected_state, readback_required, next_gate, next_node, requires_human_approval, checkpoint_required, evidence_refs, replay_status, and a deterministic decision_digest. The decision — not a side effect — is the only signal; the node never performs the transition.
constraints: The decision must be a pure function of the supplied evidence; no external state may be read or mutated.
Replay with the same idempotency key must return the same decision and decision_digest (idempotent) unless the prior decision conflicts, in which case it must BLOCK with TRANSITION_REPLAY_CONFLICT.
Exact readback of observed_task_state against current_state is required before declaring PASS; a mismatch must BLOCK with TRANSITION_READBACK_MISMATCH.
Blocking conditions are evaluated by fixed precedence; the highest-precedence blocking flag wins.
A valid result must never grant gate, G2, G3, G4, G5, or G6 authority, merge, deploy, release, or any other execution authority.
exclusions: Performing the gate transition or any state mutation.
Granting repository, PR, merge, deploy, release, or production authority.
Network access, credential, secret, migration, or destructive operations.
Changing gate authority or later-gate inheritance.
entry_guards: G2 write result reconciled and exact diff readback passed

reason_codes.TRANSITION_INPUT_INVALID: The supplied transition inputs are structurally invalid.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_REPLAY_CONFLICT: Same idempotency key produced a different semantic decision on replay; fail closed.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_BINDING_MISMATCH: The resolved binding does not match the approved scope binding.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_EVIDENCE_MISSING: Required gate evidence is absent from the evidence ledger.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_EVIDENCE_STALE: The available gate evidence is older than the required readback window.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: No approval validation was supplied; human approval is required before PASS.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_APPROVAL_INVALID: The supplied approval validation is invalid or expired.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_ENVELOPE_INACTIVE: The G2 execution envelope is not in the ACTIVE activation state.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_READBACK_REQUIRED: Observed task state is unavailable; readback is required before PASS.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_READBACK_MISMATCH: Observed task state does not match the resolved current state.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_LATER_GATE_INHERITANCE_REJECT: A later-gate inheritance claim was rejected by the boundary check.
reason_codes.TRANSITION_PASS: All guards passed; the transition is permitted and the decision is PASS.
